general.q: How Do I Register in Pakistan railways Public Recruitment Service ?
general.a: Only passed candidates of the BPS Grade 5 to 15 tests are eligible to register. To register, enter your CNIC number and the mobile number used during your test on the registration page and complete the verification process.

general.q: How can I create an account on the Pakistan Railways Public Recruitment Service portal?
general.a: Choose Register, enter your CNIC and mobile number, and enter the 6-digit verification code sent by SMS. Your permanent candidate profile is created straight away.

general.q: Can you guide me through the registration process for Pakistan Railways Public Recruitment Service?
general.a: Start by navigating to the registration page, provide your CNIC and mobile number, enter the OTP sent to your phone, and fill out your initial profile details.

general.q: Do I need a password to access my account?
general.a: No. You log in securely with your CNIC and registered mobile number, and we send a new one-time passcode (OTP) via SMS each time.

general.q: What is the procedure to sign up for Pakistan Railways Public Recruitment Service?
general.a: Visit the sign up page, enter your verified mobile number and CNIC, verify using the one-time password (OTP), and proceed to complete your candidate profile.

general.q: How do I enroll in the Pakistan Railways Public Recruitment Service system?
general.a: Enrollment is automated once you register with your CNIC and mobile number. You can then apply to any open positions matching your qualifications.

general.q: Steps to register for Pakistan Railways Public Recruitment Service online?
general.a: 1. Click Register, 2. Enter CNIC & mobile number, 3. Verify OTP, 4. Update your education and experience profile, 5. Apply to suitable vacancies.

general.q: How do I get started with registration on Pakistan Railways Public Recruitment Service?
general.a: Simply click on the Register button on the top right, enter your personal details, verify via SMS, and start exploring available positions.
